evals.name: compose-diff-redacts-secrets
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment --diff staging prod

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. deploy/staging/compose.yaml and deploy/prod/compose.yaml are tracked. Production runs api at ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 with replicas 3. Staging runs api at ghcr.io/acme/api:1.0.0 with replicas 1. Both set PASSWORD to different values. No cloud credentials are used. The authoring-formats doc sets diagram_dialect.system to c4-plantuml. containers.json is absent.
evals.expected_output: collect-deployment.sh writes deployment.json from Compose only. render-deployment.sh writes deployment.md with one fenced plantuml block holding a Deployment_Node per environment, and a diff that names the image, the replica count, and that PASSWORD differs. Neither password appears.
expectations: Runs collect-deployment.sh and render-deployment.sh
Resolves the dialect with resolve-diagram-dialect.sh --kind system and passes --dialect c4-plantuml
Reports diagram_dialect.system, c4-plantuml, and the team convention doc path as the layer
Does not call a cloud API
The artifact names compose and the two environment files
The diff reports the image change and the replica change
The diff says the secret parameter differs and does not contain either password
Says map-containers output was not present

evals.name: two-tools-refuse
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment

The repository has deploy/compose.yaml and main.tf with a Terraform resource. Both are tracked.
evals.expected_output: The record reason is partial-read. The record and any deployment.md name compose and terraform, and no deployment diagram is drawn.
expectations: Does not draw the Compose services and ignore Terraform
Names both tools
The artifact states partial-read
No deployment diagram is written

evals.name: terraform-only-refuses
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment

The only IaC is net.tf declaring an azurerm_virtual_network. The operator asked where the network is.
evals.expected_output: The record reason is adapter-not-shipped. The virtual network name is not drawn as a node.
expectations: Recognizes Terraform
Does not invent a deployment node from the resource name
The artifact states that the adapter is not shipped

evals.name: live-refuses
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment prod --live

A Compose file for prod is tracked. The operator passed --live.
evals.expected_output: The reason is live-state-requested. The Compose image is not in the record. No cloud API is called.
expectations: Passes --live to collect-deployment.sh
Does not fall through to the committed Compose file
Does not call a cloud API
The artifact states the refusal

evals.name: kubernetes-and-compose-both-read
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment

Tracked files include deploy/compose.yaml and deploy/api.yaml, a Deployment plus an Ingress host api.example.com in namespace prod. The Ingress manifest also sets PASSWORD. The authoring-formats doc sets diagram_dialect.system to likec4.
evals.expected_output: Both compose and kubernetes are shipped tools. deployment.md contains one fenced likec4 block with a deployment environment, an instanceOf placement, and a deployment view. The password is absent. The ingress host is in the record.
expectations: Reads both tools rather than declining a pair of shipped readers
Passes --dialect likec4
deployment.md contains one fenced likec4 block with instanceOf and a deployment view
api.example.com is recorded
PASSWORD's value is not in the artifact

evals.name: system-dialect-unset-emits-no-view
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. deploy/compose.yaml is tracked. The authoring-formats doc sets diagram_dialect.system to mermaid.
evals.expected_output: The resolver prints none. deployment.json is written. deployment.md carries the tables and no diagram block. The summary says dialect=none and the report gives unset (no C4 view emitted).
expectations: Runs resolve-diagram-dialect.sh --kind system
Does not emit a mermaid diagram
deployment.json is written and deployment.md has no fenced diagram block
Reports diagram_dialect.system as unset (no C4 view emitted) and names the unrecognized value
